settling_test.title: US index-futures vol target, MACRO-R06-US-FUT (R-29)
settling_test.question: US index-futures vol target, MACRO-R06-US-FUT (R-29)
settling_test.data: Kenneth R. French daily Mkt-RF and RF (BL-D23; DL-A's fetch refused, HTTP 403). Futures book at 5 bp. Objective ≥ 15% S&P episodes
settling_test.window: 1926-07 → 2026-08; decade-spaced starts; the 1990–2007 line is printed (≈ 0)
settling_test.metric: v2 CARD-P (R-21): PC-1′ (ΔES95 of 21- and 126-session returns vs S, one-sided stationary-bootstrap p ≤ 0.10, blocks ≥ 250 sessions), PC-2 with a CI, PC-3; judged under the blind v2 package
settling_test.threshold: PC-1′ holds at 1× and 2×, and the card passes at ≥ 80% of decade-spaced starts. Promotion to BUILD-AS-INSURANCE also needs a US sleeve in which one Micro ES (≈ ₩52m) is ≤ ~5% of declared notional (≈ ₩1bn), or another executable line the owner declares (D5)

settling_test.title: Protective trend card, monthly SMA10m 0.5× (R-28)
settling_test.question: Protective trend card, monthly SMA10m 0.5× (R-28)
settling_test.data: French monthly US market (local, 1927+). Each non-Korean sleeve's own official closes. Pooled-onset rule declared before any run
settling_test.window: US 1927–2026; a PASS needs pre-1970 data (DLB-T3c). Each sleeve's longest history
settling_test.metric: Increment stacked on the vol target (ΔES and ΔMDD). v2 CARD-P at 5 and 50 bp. GJR-null percentile and snooping haircut printed. No Sharpe claim
settling_test.threshold: Increment ≥ 3 pp, plus a formal v2 PASS. Tier A via the pooled-onset rule (US alone 45 de-clustered onsets). BUILD-AS-INSURANCE only once such a sleeve exists

settling_test.title: COMB = ½(GJR-t + log-HAR-range) as estimator challenger (R-30)
settling_test.question: COMB = ½(GJR-t + log-HAR-range) as estimator challenger (R-30)
settling_test.data: KOSPI and US daily OHLC with open-quality flags. Range proxies: overnight² + Garman–Klass (KOSPI); Parkinson (US; ^GSPC opens unreliable before ~2008). Formal cards use KRX official closes
settling_test.window: OOS: 2001-01-02 → 2026-09 KOSPI (6,342 origins); 1995-01-03 → 2026-09 US (7,985 origins). 2016–26 and 2026 printed separately
settling_test.metric: R-30 staged gate. Stage 1: calibration at h = 21 (FHS exceedance, 21-day fan PIT, Christoffersen CC). Stage 2: 90% QLIKE MCS at h = 21. Stage 3: vol-of-vol, ΔMDD and PC-2, net of turnover at the declared book
settling_test.threshold: Passes Stage 1; inside the MCS; lowest vol-of-vol with ΔSR non-inferior (overlapping CIs are ties → simplest surviving model). Adopted on a card only as a counted revision passing the full v2 CARD-P. ETF and futures books only; fails closed to SMA20
settling_test.owner: Claude Code · M3 (R-30); card switch = counted revision at M7
